title: AirAccount
tagline: AirAccount is an Ethereum application account framework built on Account Abstraction.
description:
**AirAccount is an Ethereum application account framework built on Account Abstraction.**
It is an Opensource framework to **Bridge** Anyone with any applications to the Ethereum.
It is a Basic **Interface** for any Instructions from Any Network to the Blockchain.
We implemented an SMS module, also a Purse to test the idea and get feedback.

Make decentralized crypto accounts available to everyone easily.
how_its_made:
How do you think about using your mobile to send an SMS and get an Ethereum account? 
And you can get and transfer tokens with your mobile phone number.
How about ENS? Email or Telegram? Discord? MetaMask Snap?  and more. 
Any applications that can bind with an Ethereum account based on account abstraction.
We try to build an Ethereum application account framework for the mass adoption of the human digital future.
AirAccount comprises Adaptors, Gateways, and Community Nodes, forming a decentralized network that safeguards your wallet.
